correctness.rationale: Applied finite Heyting duality: G_{m,n} is the upset algebra of m disjoint n-element chains and endomorphisms correspond to isotone open p-morphisms f with f[↑x]=↑f(x). Each source component maps to a single target component and surjects onto a final segment; onto a final segment of length j it has C(n-1,j-1) monotone block maps. If f²=f, every active target final segment S must be fixed pointwise, forcing its source-chain map uniquely. Every inactive chain independently maps onto a final subsegment of one of r active components, with b_n(k_i)=∑_{j<=k_i}C(n-1,j-1) choices for target i. Labeling active chains of each multiplicity c_t gives m!/[(m-r)!∏ c_t!] and the displayed product. The algebra image is exactly Upsets(S), so its factors are C_{k_i+1}; different length multisets give nonisomorphic dual posets. Counting all nonempty multisets gives C(m+n,m)-1. Independent brute-force finite p-morphism enumeration matched closed ranks for (m,n)=(1,3),(2,2),(3,1),(2,3),(3,2), including I_2,2=2z²+4z³+z⁴+2z⁶+z⁹ and 59 idempotents at m3,n2. Arbitrary powers follow from p-morphism reasoning, not finite tests.
residual_risks: Duality uses genuinely Heyting implication-preserving p-morphisms, not arbitrary bounded distributive lattice maps; the final-segment back condition is essential.
The classification concerns image isomorphism types, not embedded retract subalgebra count.

value.rationale: Finite powers of Gödel chains are a natural family in finite Heyting algebra theory, and retraction-image isomorphism types/ranks refine unrestricted hom-set and automorphism counts. The full multiset-resolved formula, C(m+n,m)-1 count, and image-rank polynomial supply precise invariants for all powers, distinguishing images with equal cardinality but nonisomorphic factors. This independently motivated complete classification uses an accessible dual structural proof, not an arbitrary small-parameter census.
residual_risks: A higher-general finite Gödel-retraction formula in protected literature could subsume the value; this has not been ruled out and no broad theorem is claimed.

final_claim: For finite Gödel chain power G_{m,n}=C_{n+1}^m, m,n>=1, every image of an idempotent Heyting endomorphism is a product of 1<=r<=m chain factors C_{k_i+1} (1<=k_i<=n), every multiset occurs, and the exact retraction multiplicity of a multiset equals m! /[(m-r)!∏ c_t!] times (∑_i ∑_{j=0}^{k_i-1} C(n-1,j))^(m-r). Hence the image rank polynomial and number C(m+n,m)-1 of isomorphism types in frozen RESULT.md.
limitations: Restricted to equal-factor finite Gödel chain powers; not arbitrary finite Heyting algebras.
